milestones.name: Defeat Elder Hu
milestones.note: Elder Hu is a boss fought in the Forgotten Crossroads area; Shade Cloak is recommended but not required

milestones.name: Acquire Love Key
milestones.note: Found on a corpse in the southeast of the Queen's Gardens above the path to the Fungal Wastes; requires Isma's Tear

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.grants: Dash through attacks including Elder Hu's Ring Slam
abilities.note: Highly recommended for Elder Hu fight; allows dodging Ring Slam attack

abilities.name: Howling Wraiths
abilities.note: Spell usable to quickly defeat Elder Hu, pairs well with Spell build

abilities.name: Abyss Shriek
abilities.note: Upgraded spell usable to quickly defeat Elder Hu, pairs well with Spell build

abilities.name: Isma's Tear
abilities.grants: Access to Love Key location in Queen's Gardens
abilities.note: Required to retrieve the Love Key

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.note: Found on a corpse in the southeast of Queen's Gardens above the path to Fungal Wastes; used in City of Tears

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Attacks with Ring Curtain (pairs of rings slamming from edges to centre) and Teleport. Floats low enough to hit with the Nail.

objectives.name: Dodge Elder Hu's Ring Curtain attack
objectives.hopDescription: Time dashes between the rings as they slam from the arena edges toward the centre; Shade Cloak simplifies this
objectives.note: Elder Hu stays in place during attacks and floats low — counter with Nail hits between ring pairs or use Spell build with Shade Cloak

objectives.name: Obtain Isma's Tear
objectives.hopDescription: Acquire Isma's Tear to gain access to the Love Key corpse location

objectives.name: Retrieve Love Key from Queen's Gardens
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to the southeast of Queen's Gardens, above the path to Fungal Wastes, and collect the Love Key from a corpse

objectives.name: Use Love Key in City of Tears
objectives.hopDescription: Bring the Love Key to its corresponding location in the City of Tears

connectors.description: Path from Queen's Gardens leads down to the Fungal Wastes; the Love Key is found above this path
Love Key acquired in Queen's Gardens is used in the City of Tears
